RedWallet — Lightning display and invoice update

New in this build
• A compact red activity panel keeps progress, results and errors visible while you scroll.
• Open, active, inactive, pending and closing channel counts refresh automatically while the screen is in use.
• Channel details show the peer, funding transaction, local balance and remaining confirmations when reported by LND.
• Receive invoices appear as QR codes. Tap the QR to view the text; Copy and Share include the full invoice.
• Improved scrolling, keyboard dismissal and input contrast.
• The previously unlabeled value is now clearly labeled Fee rate (sat/vB).
• Channel-opening feedback explains that another confirmation creates another channel.

Existing Lightning functionality
Embedded LND for public XBT mainnet, optional custom chain peers, peer connections, private channels, invoices, payment review/history, funding addresses, cooperative closure, reviewed on-chain withdrawals and encrypted recovery exports.

Current limitations
Tor-only/.onion Lightning peers are not supported in this build. A clear explanation is shown for those attempts. Closing or locking the phone can suspend the node; background Lightning and CoinJoin completion are not guaranteed. The Lightning node has its own balance and recovery file. Full channel-fund recovery after losing a device has not yet been demonstrated. This is a TestFlight beta.
